verifying.title: Verifying your email
verifying.description: We are confirming your account. This will only take a moment.

success.title: Email verified!
success.description: Your account has been successfully activated. You can now sign in.

expired.title: This link is no longer valid
expired.description: This verification link has expired or has already been used. Request a new one to activate your account.

error.title: We couldn't verify your email
error.description: Something went wrong while verifying your account. Request a new verification link or contact support.

resend.title: Need a new link?
resend.success: We sent a new verification link to your email.

errors.USER_NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find an account with that email.
errors.USER_ALREADY_CONFIRMED: This email has already been verified. You can now sign in.
errors.fallback: An error occurred. If the problem persists, please contact support.
